scenes.text: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around two thousand five hundred and sixty B C.
Cleopatra died in thirty B C, about two and a half thousand years later.
The Moon landing happened in nineteen sixty nine, only about two thousand years after her.
So to Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient history.
What other history fact sounds fake but is true?

title: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than the pyramids 🤯
caption: The Great Pyramid was finished around 2560 BC. Cleopatra died in 30 BC, about 2,500 years later. The Moon landing was in 1969, about 2,000 years after her. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient! 👑
